description: This file defines a custom desktop pane component (MDIDesktopPane) extending JDesktopPane, and a nested class MDIDesktopManager that manages internal frame resizing and scrollbar behavior. It provides Multiple Document Interface (MDI) functionality with features like cascading, tiling, and dynamic scroll handling in a Swing application.

classes.name: MDIDesktopPane
classes.description: A custom extension of JDesktopPane supporting additional MDI functionality including frame management, cascading, tiling, and scroll bar handling.

methods.name: MDIDesktopPane
methods.description: Constructor initializing the desktop pane and setting a custom desktop manager.

methods.name: setBounds
methods.description: Overrides to set bounds and check desktop size.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a JInternalFrame to the desktop, positioning it, setting size, and updating UI components.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a component and updates toolbar and desktop size.

methods.name: cascadeFrames
methods.description: Arranges internal frames in a cascade pattern.

methods.name: tileFrames
methods.description: Arranges internal frames in a tiled pattern.

methods.name: setAllSize
methods.description: Sets size properties for all component size attributes.

methods.name: checkDesktopSize
methods.description: Checks and updates desktop size by invoking resize on the desktop manager.

classes.name: MDIDesktopManager
classes.description: A private class extending DefaultDesktopManager to override resizing behavior, providing scroll management for the MDIDesktopPane.

methods.name: MDIDesktopManager
methods.description: Constructor linking to the desktop pane.

methods.name: endResizingFrame
methods.description: Overrides to trigger resize after resizing.

methods.name: endDraggingFrame
methods.description: Overrides to trigger resize after dragging.

methods.name: setNormalSize
methods.description: Adjusts the desktop size to a 'normal' state, considering scroll pane insets.

methods.name: getScrollPaneInsets
methods.description: Returns insets of the scroll pane border.

methods.name: getScrollPane
methods.description: Retrieves the JScrollPane that contains the desktop, if any.

methods.name: resizeDesktop
methods.description: Calculates and sets the desktop size based on contained internal frames, handling scroll pane dimensions.
